Sinestro Corps

Kryb

A Sinestro Corps threat to Lantern families.

Kryb is a Sinestro Corps antagonist whose attacks target Lantern families. Sins of the Star Sapphire offers a focused story about the threat she poses beyond battlefield combat.

Continuity: Main DC comics continuity; this profile follows the cited era rather than asserting a permanent present-day status.

Affiliation
Sinestro Corps
First appearance
Green Lantern: Sinestro Corps Special #1 (August 2007)
Story history — History and later developments — spoilers

Kryb’s pursuit of children turns the fear Corps’ violence toward family bonds. Green Lantern Corps #31 and #32 place Kyle Rayner and Soranik Natu against her over Amnee and Matoo’s infant son. This is a more concrete reading route than a generic claim that she appears throughout every Lantern event.

Key Stories

  • Sins of the Star Sapphire
    Green Lantern Corps (2006) #27–32 (2008–2009)
